en: Fixed `claude plugin eval` refusing every Bash-granting run on Macs with Docker Desktop (links under `~/.docker/bin`); the refusal now names which part of a credential store held the link
zh: 修复了 `claude plugin eval` 在装有 Docker Desktop 的 Mac 上拒绝所有授予 Bash 的运行（`~/.docker/bin` 下的链接）的问题；拒绝信息现在会指明凭据存储中持有该链接的部分
